summary: Fukui City’s first-party ふくいマップ public GIS and its current viewer were verified. The public service exposes local road, urban-planning and land-readjustment/conversion-map categories. The inspected viewer JavaScript exposes generic search/layer responders, but direct bounded anonymous requests without the runtime payload/session returned 404 and no safe native parcel ID plus full polygon geometry was obtained. No GeoJSON sample is retained; runtime remains held.

No credentials, private tokens, CAPTCHA bypass, unsafe fields or TLS-verification bypass were used.
